currency.name: Marks
currency.history: Early colony stores recorded claims on labor and materials as ledger marks. Municipal clearing houses later standardized those accounts; modern banking kept the name. Marks are money, while supplies and construction materials remain physical stock.
currency.scope: Your administration's treasury and the local value of trade settlements. Other nations need not use the same currency.

police.name: Civic watch
police.description: Road-connected, powered watch station reduces crime within 9 tiles. 0.65 Marks/day.

fire.name: Fire & rescue
fire.description: Reduces fire risk within 10 tiles when connected and powered. 0.75 Marks/day.

clinic.name: Neighborhood clinic
clinic.description: Improves workforce productivity within 8 tiles. Requires road access and power. 0.65 Marks/day.

transit.name: Shuttle stop
transit.description: Two connected, powered stops form a shuttle network. Nearby lots tolerate longer commutes. 0.25 Marks/day each.

road.name: Transit road
road.description: Drag to connect districts to the spaceport.

habitat.name: Habitat zone
habitat.description: Homes grow with jobs, life support and local suitability.

industry.name: Industry zone
industry.description: Creates jobs and construction materials. Keep pollution away from homes.

service.name: Service zone
service.description: Produces supplies and improves nearby residential desirability.

power.name: Fusion generator
power.description: Provides 32 power. Frozen sites near geothermal vents produce 48.

life_support.name: Life support
life_support.description: Supports growth within 9 tiles. Arid sites near water use less power.

extractor.name: Mineral extractor
extractor.description: Build within 3 tiles of a mineral deposit for strong material output.

spaceport.name: Spaceport
spaceport.description: Colony hub, starter utilities and trade access.

terraformer.name: Climate array
terraformer.description: Enables a warming or water-recovery project on a harsh world.

temperate.name: Temperate
temperate.description: Fertile land supports open development. Industry lowers nearby residential suitability.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.description: Heating is expensive. Geothermal vents favor compact, efficient settlements.

arid.name: Arid
arid.description: Water is scarce. Place life support and homes near blue aquifers.

factions.name: Veyr Directorate
factions.bonus: Industrial discipline: pays more for materials.
factions.reason: Your frontier remains outside our claims.

factions.name: Orin Consortium
factions.reason: A new partner is a new opportunity.

factions.name: Thalen Commune
factions.reason: Leave room for the living world.

discoveries.title: The silent archive
discoveries.text: A buried observatory holds a map of ancient migration routes.

discoveries.title: A garden under glass
discoveries.text: A sealed ecosystem survived beneath an abandoned dome.

discoveries.title: A wandering beacon
discoveries.text: A signal buoy still charts safe approaches through the dust.

discoveries.title: The crystal lattice
discoveries.text: Mineral formations store a faint and intricate electrical charge.

discoveries.title: Seeds of another sun
discoveries.text: A drifting seed vault contains remarkably adaptable plants.

discoveries.title: The last relay
discoveries.text: An intact relay once connected settlements beyond this sector.
